Cost of living rated Not testable: she praised the child tax credit in 2024 but made no clear pledge to expand it. A stricter reading would test it against H.R.1 (which raised the credit) and rate it Contradicted.
Gun regulation: the only gun-related roll call found (Murphy amendment, roll call 473, Aug 2025) required a report and did not test a ban or background checks.
